description: Apple App Store charts, listings, ratings and reviews for any storefront from one Go binary, with a local history that turns repeated captures into rank, listing-change and traction trends.

novel_features.name: Traction by storefront
novel_features.description: See per-country demand signals for any app, rolled up daily, monthly, annually or all-time: new ratings, chart rank and review volume, clearly labelled as proxies.

novel_features.name: Release and change impact
novel_features.description: Compare rank, new ratings, review stars and keyword positions in equal windows before and after a release, listing change or date.

novel_features.name: Cross-app change feed
novel_features.description: One dated feed of every change across your tracked apps: new versions, title and subtitle edits, price and in-app purchase price changes, privacy labels, events and featuring.

novel_features.name: Keyword share of voice
novel_features.description: See which apps hold the top search results across a set of tracked terms and how that share moved since the last capture.

novel_features.name: Multi-storefront breakouts
novel_features.description: Find apps climbing or entering the same chart in several countries at once.
